ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCY AGREEMENT
Dated: 13/07/2025
Tenancy ref: HME/22/6569  |  Prepared by Halden & Moor Estates

This agreement is intended to create an assured shorthold tenancy as defined in section 19A of the Housing Act 1988 and the provisions for the recovery of possession by the Landlord in section 21 of that Act may apply (subject to any changes made by the Renters' Rights Act 2025).

PARTICULARS

| Field | Details |
|---|---|
| Landlord | Colm Ó Ceallaigh Roofing |
| Tenant | Uchenna Oyelaran |
| Property | Flat 48D, Navigation Point, 179 Stanley Way, Liverpool, L12 5XL |
| Start date | 10th August 2025 |
| Term | 6 months |
| Rent | £1,355.00 per month |
| Deposit | £1,563.46 |
| Deposit scheme | the Tenancy Deposit Scheme |
| Agent | Halden & Moor Estates |

Bank details for rent
Account name:   Colm Ó Ceallaigh
Sort code:      23-26-12
Account number: 09221442
Reference:      HME/22/6569

Interpretation

"Landlord" means Colm Ó Ceallaigh Roofing and includes any person who later becomes entitled to the reversion of the Property.
"Tenant" means Uchenna Oyelaran. Where there is more than one, the obligations are joint and several.
"Property" means Flat 48D, Navigation Point, 179 Stanley Way, Liverpool, L12 5XL and includes the Fixtures and Fittings.
"Rent" means £1,355.00 per month or such other sum as may be agreed or determined.
"Deposit" means the sum of £1,563.46 held under clause 3.1.
"Fixtures and Fittings" means the items listed in the Inventory.
"Communal Areas" means the entrance, stairs, bin store and the courtyard known as Grace Court.
"Utilities" means gas, electricity, water, sewerage, telecommunications and broadband.
"Agent" means Halden & Moor Estates or any other agent appointed by the Landlord.

Terms of the tenancy

SECTION 2 - RENT
2.1  The Rent is £1,355.00 per month. It is payable in advance, the first payment being due on or before 10th August 2025, and thereafter on the 1st of each month.

2.2 If any Rent is unpaid for 14 days after it falls due, the Tenant will pay interest at 3% above the Bank of England base rate from the date it was due until the date it is paid, as permitted by the Tenant Fees Act 2019.

2.3  The Landlord may, acting in good faith, allow a short grace period where the Tenant has notified the Landlord in advance of a delay.

2.4	The Tenant is responsible for paying council tax, water and sewerage charges, gas, electricity, telephone, broadband and the television licence for the Property during the Term.

Page 1 of 3

Assured Shorthold Tenancy Agreement - 179 Stanley Way

SECTION 3 - DEPOSIT
3.1	A deposit of £1,563.46 is payable on signing. It will be registered with the Tenancy Deposit Scheme, an authorised tenancy deposit scheme, within 30 days.

3.2  At the end of the tenancy the Landlord may deduct from the Deposit reasonable costs for damage beyond fair wear and tear, unpaid Rent and unpaid utility bills, and will return the balance within 10 days of agreement.

3.3	No holding deposit is held. Where a holding deposit of £340 was paid it has been credited against the first month's Rent.

SECTION 4 - TENANT'S OBLIGATIONS
4.1  The Tenant must keep the inside of the Property clean and in good condition and must not damage it or the contents.

4.2	Not to assign, sublet, take in lodgers or part with possession of the whole or any part of the Property.

4.3  Pets: no pets are permitted other than one indoor cat which the Landlord has agreed to in writing.

4.4	Not to smoke or vape inside the Property and to ensure that visitors do not do so.

4.5  Not to cause a nuisance or annoyance to neighbours, including excessive noise between 11pm and 7am.

4.6	To keep the garden tidy and the lawns cut, and not to remove any trees or shrubs. The communal areas, including the courtyard known as Grace Court, are shared with other residents and must be kept clear.

4.7  To put refuse and recycling out for collection on the correct days and not to leave rubbish in the communal areas.

4.8	To report any disrepair or defect to the Landlord or the Agent promptly, and in any event within 7 days of becoming aware of it.

4.9  To heat and air the Property properly so that condensation does not build up, particularly in the bathroom and bedrooms. To ventilate the Property adequately and to take reasonable steps to prevent condensation.

4.10 Not to change the locks or have additional keys cut without consent, and to return all keys at the end of the tenancy.

4.11	No alterations: the Tenant must not paint, drill or alter the Property without permission.

4.12  The Tenant is advised to take out contents insurance. The Landlord is not liable for loss of the Tenant's belongings.

SECTION 5 - INSURANCE
5.1 The Landlord will insure the building against the usual risks. The Tenant must not do anything that would make the insurance void or increase the premium.

5.2 Rent suspension applies where the Property cannot be lived in because of fire or flood, except where the Tenant is at fault. If the Property is made uninhabitable by an insured risk, the Rent will stop being payable until it is fit to live in again, unless the damage was caused by the Tenant.

Page 2 of 3

Halden & Moor Estates  HME/22/6569

SECTION 6 - ACCESS
6.1	The Tenant will allow the Landlord or the Agent access to the Property at reasonable times on at least 24 hours' written notice to inspect its condition or carry out repairs.

6.2  Where there is an emergency such as a flood or fire, access may be taken immediately.

6.3  The Agent will carry out a routine visit around every 4 months and send a short report to the Landlord.

SECTION 7 - ENDING THE TENANCY
7.1 If the Tenant breaks the terms of this agreement, the Landlord may apply to the court for possession under the Housing Act 1988.

7.2  The Tenant may end the tenancy after the fixed term by giving at least one month's written notice ending on the last day of a rental period.

7.3	On leaving, the Tenant will arrange a professional clean if the Property was professionally cleaned at the start, as recorded in the check-in report.

SECTION 8 - LANDLORD'S OBLIGATIONS
8.1 To ensure that a smoke alarm is fitted on every storey and a carbon monoxide alarm in any room with a fixed combustion appliance.

8.2 To allow the Tenant quiet enjoyment of the Property without interruption by the Landlord or anyone acting on the Landlord's behalf, provided the Tenant complies with this agreement.

8.3 The Tenant notes that the Mill Lane roadworks are scheduled during the Term; the Landlord will pass on any notices from the council.

8.4 The Landlord will arrange an annual gas safety check and provide the certificate within 28 days, as required by the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998.

SECTION 9 - NOTICES
9.1  Notices to the Tenant may be served by leaving them at the Property or by email to the address given in Schedule 1.

SECTION 10 - DATA PROTECTION
10.1 Personal data will be handled under the Data Protection Act 2018. The Agent's privacy notice is available on request.

SECTION 11 - GENERAL
11.1 Where there is more than one tenant, their obligations are joint and several.

11.2  The courts of England and Wales have jurisdiction over any dispute.

11.3	The Landlord and the Tenant agree to act in good faith when dealing with any dispute.

Signed as an agreement

Signed by the Landlord [signature]
Name: Colm Ó Ceallaigh
Date: August 4, 2025

Signed by the Tenant ..............................
Name: UCHENNA OYELARAN
Date: ________
